I recall you mentioning how these techniques have helped improve your stress levels. Additionally, the meditation app you developed seems to have played a significant role in this improvement. How has the integration of AI tools into your workflow supported these efforts?
The AI tools have been instrumental in streamlining my workflow, allowing me to focus more on strategic planning and delegation. This has been crucial in managing my workload effectively.

That's excellent, Michelle. Strategic planning and delegation are key components in handling increased responsibilities, especially in an executive role. Your ability to leverage AI tools not only enhances productivity but also supports your stress management efforts. It's important to acknowledge the support from your team as well, which you've expressed gratitude for, in managing the pressures of your role.
